name: Family Journey with Mobility & Caregiver Dependency
disclaimer: SIMULATED DATA - FOR DEMONSTRATION AND PLANNING ONLY - NOT OFFICIAL IRCTC STATUS

mobilityProfile.notes: Limited mobility, knee osteoarthritis, cannot use stairs
Primary caregiver to P1; must stay co-located
Needs adjacent guardian, adds childcare and luggage stroller overhead
Low vision/blindness; navigates using screen reader and keyboard
Fast walker, handles heavy luggage, can split if family rules permit
